correctness.rationale: Represent the empirical bridge by centered binary partial sums S_k and use zero-sum identity T=-sum_(r<s)(s-r)Y_rY_s. Exchangeability yields E[Y_rY_s] and overlap-conditioned three classes for edge transitions D_i; exact distance-weight sums lead Cov(R,T)=-Nh(2Nh-1)/3. Fourth-order exchangeable moments and pair overlap weights yield Var(T)=N^2*h*(N+1)*(4(N+1)*h-3)/180; standard transition counting gives Var(R)=2Nh(2Nh-1)/(N-1), hence all normalized identities. N=3 is handled directly; N=2 correlation undefined and excluded. Independent exhaustive exact-Fraction enumeration of every fixed-composition binary word for all 44 cases (N,a), 3<=N<=10, confirmed all means, variances and covariance. The asymptotic coefficient follows by symbolic division with h->p(1-p)>0.
